evidence_review.method: Read the exact frozen law and selected cell and branch. Inspect each supplied accepted metadata summary and compare stated conditions; preserve accepted recordings without replay. This checkpoint identifies uncovered branches without claiming a complete executable plan.

gaps.requirement: No accepted recordings are supplied for this assignment. The exact text, selected branch, exceptions, timing and source observations still require a finite controlled case comparison and an executable delivery package.
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: The exported accepted-evidence inventory does not demonstrate the listed full-text coverage; new cases or source-backed existing-evidence equivalence must be prepared.

full_text_branch_inventory.branch: Backward vehicle motion with reasonable safety and no interference with other traffic.
Compare controlled opposing-traffic/no-conflict conditions and interference conditions while maintaining reverse maneuver.
Reasonable safety is a judgment phrase without a statutory numeric cutoff.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: The driver shall not back unless the movement can be made with reasonable safety and without interfering with other traffic.
